name: Yamaha XS1100
engine: 1101 cc air-cooled DOHC inline four, four carbs, shaft drive
intro: Yamaha's big shaft-drive four. Tough engine, but the ignition wiring is a known weak spot.

add.title: Check the pulser coil wires
add.instructions: Take off the left lower cover and inspect the braided wires from the pulser coils to the harness. Look for breaks near the splice.
add.reason: Broken pulser wires are a common reason two cylinders stop firing.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.

known.title: Pulser coil wires
known.what: The braided wires to the pulser coils break and kill two cylinders.
